sections.Profile:
The Mystery Castle pinball machine, produced by Alvin G. and Company in 1993, is a rare, horror-themed game with only 227 units made. Designed by Michael Gottlieb and Wally Welch, the game features three flippers, three ramps, two multiball modes, and six drop targets.

- Manufacturer: Alvin G. and Company
- Years made: 1993
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Castles, Ghosts, Knights, Medieval, Original Theme, 1990s, Solid State, Horror
